bha_summary: Running 9-5/8" Casing String (47# L-80 VAM TOP)
operations_summary: Rigged up casing handling equipment. Ran 168 joints of 9-5/8" 47# L-80 casing to 2175 m. Washed last 2 joints to bottom. Circulated casing volume. Cemented casing with 45 m3 lead cement (1.55 sg) and 18 m3 tail cement (1.90 sg). Bumped plug with 210 bar.
remarks: Cement returns to mudline confirmed. Floats holding.
